page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It utilizes the x86_64 architecture and supports instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX512F, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. No local storage or GPU accelerators are bundled with this instance type, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance divergence between single-threaded and multi-threaded operations. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core CPU tests, Geekbench single-core scores, and bzip3 single-threaded decompression falling into the bottom 25% tier, while single-threaded gzip compression registers in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core and parallelized workloads demonstrate average performance, placing in the middle 50% tier for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth tests for both cached small blocks and uncached large blocks also align with the average tier.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource ratio, this instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads that do not rely heavily on high single-core clock speeds. Factual benchmark results show average performance in database operations, Redis SET operations, static web serving, and software compilation. Qualitative cost efficiency is characterized by its legacy Intel Xeon hardware profile, which offers a stable multi-core resource density for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, and moderate database workloads, though it presents a performance-per-core tradeoff for single-threaded tasks.
